test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the underlined words. 

Whatever topic I discussed with the sage, it seemed that he __knew everything__.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **“was omniscient”** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this context it is stated that whatever the speaker discussed with the sage, he knew all the things.
 
• **Omniscient : (सर्वज्ञ)** - Knowing everything.
 
 
• **Example:** In the novel, the narrator is an omniscient character who knows every detail about the events and characters.
